{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) WebGIS Plugin: Map reading, map manipulation, and 3D world comprehension.","id":"gh:1358781196","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"DSH-WebGIS","slug":"Mekansm1/DSH-WebGIS","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins","dsh-skill","gis","gis-data","gis-project","webgis"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) WebGIS Plugin: Map reading, map manipulation, and 3D world comprehension."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-webgis"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A WebGIS plugin that lets LLMs truly see the geographic world. Built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH), it e"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"mbeds a full GIS workbench into an AI conversation: models can load map data, understand maps, and r"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"un spatial analysis through dialogue. Its long-term goal is genuine 3D spatial understanding."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Author: Frank Wang · Feedback: cywanghn@gmail.com"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- WebGIS `0.2.2` targets **DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`** and **Node.js `>=24.9.0`**. For WebGIS `0.2.1`, use DS"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"H `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- The DSH **Web profile** setup uses the host's `webServer` service.
- Install WebGI"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"S 0.2.2 with `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1 plugin --profile web add dsh-webgis@0.2.2`.
- pn"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"pm ≥ 10 needs no `approve-builds` step: DuckDB ships as the official Node Neo package (`@duckdb/node"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"-api`) with a platform-specific prebuilt binding through optional dependencies. A normal `pnpm insta"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ll` is sufficient. The platform still has to be one DuckDB Node Neo supports, and packages must be f"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"etchable from the npm registry."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What's New in 0.2.2"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **DSH Web compatibility.** Updated the harness dependencies to target DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`.
- **Map in"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"teraction.** Restored dragging in GIS mode, kept the map visible while opening the conversation mode"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"l picker, and gave the Plugins screen priority over the map.
- **Raster screenshot picking.** The vi"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"sion model estimates the target's horizontal and vertical position on a 0–1 scale. Normalization aim"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"s to improve picking accuracy when images are resized. The WGS84 conversion uses the viewport saved "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"with the screenshot, and the resulting coordinates remain visual estimates.
- **AI feature creation."},{"id":"p8s7","text":"** Added tools to create a point layer from one or more points, a line layer from ordered vertices, "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"and a polygon layer from a validated outer ring.
- **Screenshot capture.** Matched each capture to i"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ts own request and kept recent screenshots available within their conversation so later map clicks d"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"o not replace the image used for picking."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What's New in 0.2.1"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Harness 0.2.1 adaptation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Retargeted at DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`. All harness APIs this plugin uses are unchanged (slot registry, `she"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ll.overlay` / `settings.plugins.tab` / `conversation.session.header.actions`, `ctx.tools.*`, `ctx.sl"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ots.*`, `webServer.register`, session-list lookup); only dependency ranges moved. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"invariants` was dropped — it was never used by this plugin and has no 0.2.1 release."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### UI fixes"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What's New in 0.2.0"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## What's New in 0.1.5"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Failures now say what went wrong"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- A browser-to-host reply that fails is no longer swallowed. Screenshot and basemap replies used to "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"discard transport errors silently, leaving a bare timeout as the only symptom; a failed reply is now"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" reported back and surfaced as a named error.
- Those timeouts also name their cause — whether the b"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"rowser never connected, connected but is not attached to this conversation, or is polling normally a"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"nd simply did not finish the step."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What's New in 0.1.4"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Added a Worker-based execution path for geometry and spatial-statistics operations, selected by op"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"eration-specific workload thresholds.
- Worker jobs forward cancellation signals, enforce time budge"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ts, and terminate on completion, cancellation or timeout. Plugin disposal requests cleanup of active"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" workers and queued jobs.
- Added transferable geometry payloads, bounded job concurrency, shared ti"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"meout policies, and regression tests for encoding, dispatch, cancellation and timeouts.
- Added a re"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"gular-grid size guard with actionable input guidance."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Scope: small workloads still execute synchronously on the host thread. Workload thresholds do not gu"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"arantee that every complex geometry runs off-thread; this release does not promise universally non-b"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"locking execution. Worker payload encoding and result decoding also require host-thread work."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"This release's DSH `0.1.5-rc1` baseline was superseded in 0.1.5. See Compatibility."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## What's New in 0.1.3"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- Migrated to DuckDB's official Node Neo driver (`@duckdb/node-api`). Installing the plugin no longe"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"r requires compiling the legacy `duckdb` native module, `pnpm approve-builds`, or `pnpm rebuild duck"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"db`.
- Optimized very large CSV coordinate-point layers: DuckDB reads coordinates in columnar chunks"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" and builds GeoArrow directly, avoiding huge numbers of `{ lon, lat }` JavaScript objects.
- Samplin"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"g, viewport culling, empty-view behavior, and picking semantics remain unchanged. Line, polygon, and"},{"id":"p23s6","text":" geometry-column layers continue to use the established WKB conversion path."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## What's New in 0.1.2"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Adapted for DSH `0.1.5-rc1`: retargeted the new shell layout (the conversation moved into the host"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" `main` slot) and migrated to the 0.1.5 package set.
- Export vector features from the basemap. “Exp"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ort the map data in the current view” extracts real vector-tile features into new point, line, and p"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"olygon layers; a request such as “export the rivers” can limit the output to one kind.
- Added a spa"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"tial-statistics suite: Gini, Shannon entropy, and Getis-Ord Gi\* hot-spot analysis with Benjamini–Ho"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"chberg FDR correction, in addition to Moran's I. Each index inspects fields, reports what it finds, "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"and asks you to confirm inputs before computing.
- Unified click highlighting: polygons use a deep-b"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"lue outline and blue fill, lines use a thick blue stroke, and points use blue dots, always rendered "},{"id":"p25s9","text":"line and blue fill, lines use a thick blue stroke, and points use blue dots, always rendered on top."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## What's New in 0.1.1"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Fixed the “API key required” watermark on the default Carto raster basemap.
- Fixed Carto vector b"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"asemaps (Positron / Dark / Voyager) not rendering.
- Added a Measure tool: line length, snapping to "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"previously drawn vertices, and closing a polygon at its start point to show perimeter and area.
- Im"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"proved loading performance for very large SHP files."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Create features from coordinates"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Use `webgis_create_point`, `webgis_create_line`, or `webgis_create_polygon` to add a new layer. Pass"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" WGS84 `[longitude, latitude]` for a point or an ordered list of coordinate pairs for a line or poly"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"gon. Polygon creation closes the outer ring automatically and rejects self-intersections and zero-ar"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ea rings. For multiple points in the same layer, pass `points` with a `coordinates` pair and optiona"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"l `name` and `properties` for each point."}],"truncated":true}
